controls.name: Network Security Control Processes
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for installing and maintaining network security controls are defined and understood.

points_of_focus.description: Security policies and operational procedures are documented

controls.name: Network Security Control Configuration
controls.description: Network security controls are configured and maintained.

points_of_focus.description: Rulesets are reviewed at least every six months

controls.name: Cardholder Data Environment Access
controls.description: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted.

points_of_focus.description: Inbound traffic is restricted to what is necessary

controls.name: System Component Configuration
controls.description: System components are configured and managed securely.

controls.name: Wireless Environment Security
controls.description: Wireless environments are configured and managed securely.

controls.name: Sensitive Authentication Data
controls.description: Sensitive authentication data is not stored after authorization.

points_of_focus.description: SAD is not retained after authorization

controls.name: Primary Account Number Protection
controls.description: Primary account number is secured wherever it is stored.

controls.name: Cardholder Data Transmission
controls.description: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks.

points_of_focus.description: Strong cryptography and protocols are used

controls.name: Malicious Software Prevention
controls.description: Malicious software is prevented, or detected and addressed.

points_of_focus.description: Anti-malware is deployed on applicable components

controls.name: Bespoke Software Security
controls.description: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely.

controls.name: Vulnerability Identification and Management
controls.description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed.

points_of_focus.description: Patches are applied within defined windows

controls.name: Public-Facing Web Application Protection
controls.description: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks.

points_of_focus.description: Applications are assessed or protected by an automated solution

controls.name: Access Assignment
controls.description: Access to system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned.
controls.domain: Requirement 7 — Restrict Access by Business Need to Know

points_of_focus.description: Access is assigned by role and need to know

controls.name: Access Control Systems
controls.description: Access to system components and data is managed via an access control system.
controls.domain: Requirement 7 — Restrict Access by Business Need to Know

points_of_focus.description: An access control system enforces the policy

controls.name: User Identification
controls.description: User identification and related accounts for users and administrators are strictly managed.
controls.domain: Requirement 8 — Identify Users and Authenticate Access

points_of_focus.description: Every user has a unique ID

controls.name: Strong Authentication
controls.description: Strong authentication for users and administrators is established and managed.
controls.domain: Requirement 8 — Identify Users and Authenticate Access

points_of_focus.description: Passwords meet complexity and rotation rules

controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is implemented to secure access into the cardholder data environment.
controls.domain: Requirement 8 — Identify Users and Authenticate Access

points_of_focus.description: MFA is required for all remote access
MFA is required for all CDE access

controls.name: Media Protection
controls.description: Media with cardholder data is securely stored, accessed, distributed, and destroyed.

controls.name: Audit Log Implementation
controls.description: Audit logs are implemented to support the detection of anomalies and suspicious activity, and the forensic analysis of events.

points_of_focus.description: Logs capture the required event types
Logs record the required data elements

controls.name: Audit Log Protection
controls.description: Audit logs are protected from destruction and unauthorized modifications.

controls.name: Audit Log Review
controls.description: Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.

points_of_focus.description: Critical logs are reviewed at least daily

controls.name: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: External and internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified, prioritized, and addressed.

points_of_focus.description: Internal scans run at least quarterly
External ASV scans run at least quarterly

controls.name: Penetration Testing
controls.description: External and internal penetration testing is regularly performed, and exploitable vulnerabilities and security weaknesses are corrected.

points_of_focus.description: Testing is performed at least annually

controls.name: Information Security Policy
controls.description: A comprehensive information security policy that governs and provides direction for protection of the entity's information assets is known and current.
controls.domain: Requirement 12 — Support Information Security with Policies

points_of_focus.description: Policy is reviewed at least annually

controls.name: Security Awareness Education
controls.description: Security awareness education is an ongoing activity.
controls.domain: Requirement 12 — Support Information Security with Policies

points_of_focus.description: Training is delivered on hire and at least annually

controls.name: Third-Party Service Provider Management
controls.description: Risk to information assets associated with third-party service provider relationships is managed.
controls.domain: Requirement 12 — Support Information Security with Policies

controls.name: Incident Response Readiness
controls.description: Suspected and confirmed security incidents that could impact the cardholder data environment are responded to immediately.
controls.domain: Requirement 12 — Support Information Security with Policies

points_of_focus.description: The plan is tested at least annually
